objections.claim: The Phase-A pre-activation whitelist has no sound binding to the PR bytes the controller merges. A5 requires a closed, content-addressed whitelist before later slices are implemented, so it cannot contain their final head/blob digests; if entries instead address slice descriptions or self-reported IDs, an unrelated PR can claim a whitelisted identity. The Eye acceptance binds repo/PR/head/base/plan_ref but not a whitelist entry or slice descriptor, and no deterministic diff-to-entry predicate is specified. Therefore the `slice-not-whitelisted` regression would not discriminate listed work from an unlisted change, leaving the Eye-mandated activation-deferred scope boundary unenforced. Bind each finalized PR head to an immutable Phase-A slice descriptor through an Eye-signed authorization field and have the controller verify that binding plus the descriptor's closed change-surface constraints before mutation.
